DJ Set

Blend x SEDS with Anfisa Letyago

Σάββατο 21 Φεβρουαρίου στις 23:59 | Oddity

The bass drops and your chest cavity becomes part of the sound system. Anfisa Letyago has that effect — the productions that made her name hit frequencies designed to rearrange your interior architecture.

Blend and SEDS have coordinated to bring Letyago to Oddity, a combination that promises more than the sum of its bookings. Blend's reputation for progressive and melodic programming meets Letyago's harder edge, creating a tension the evening will have to resolve. SEDS adds the party expertise that ensures the resolution happens on the dance floor.

Letyago arrives in Athens at a career peak. The Drumcode releases, the festival headline slots, the touring schedule that touches every continent with a sound system — all of it builds toward nights in rooms this size, where 200 people experience what stadiums only approximate. The intimacy matters. At Oddity, you see her work.

The Thissio venue provides the counterweight to the music's industrial intentions. Oddity built its identity on sounds gentler than this, which means tonight's takeover carries extra charge. The regulars who know the room for melodic journeys meet the Letyago devotees who came for pressure. By 3am, the distinction has dissolved — everyone's dancing to whatever she's playing.

If you need the build-and-release of progressive techno, if you want your peaks telegraphed in advance, Letyago's approach works differently. She escalates without offering exit routes, trusting the room to match her intensity. But if you've been waiting for one of electronic music's most vital talents to prove what she can do in an intimate room — tonight, Oddity discovers what happens when the small space meets the big sound.

Anfisa Letyago in 200 square meters. Do the math.
